requirements: Claude Code on Windows, Mac or Linux; the first run installs its free tools (Python, FFmpeg, a local Kokoro voice). ElevenLabs is optional.

preview.description: A 56-second animated science Short in the flat-vector explainer style: the claim on a title card, a chain of checked facts drawn as pictures, and big numbers turned into everyday things.
